title: Higher-Order Masking-Strength Analysis in the Bounded Moment Model
summary: Existing quantitative masking-strength analysis is limited to first-order leakages; extending it to higher-order leakages within the bounded moment model remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Develop, within the bounded moment model, a quantitative analysis of masking strength for higher-order leakages that extends the existing quantitative analysis currently limited to first-order leakages.

scope.domain: Side-channel cryptanalysis of masking schemes in the bounded moment leakage model.
parameters: Leakage order, with first-order leakage as the existing baseline and higher-order leakage as the target
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop a quantitative analysis of masking strength for higher-order leakages within the bounded moment model that extends the first-order analysis.

citations.label: Parallel Implementations of Masking Schemes and the Bounded Moment Leakage Model

progress.summary: The source presents the bounded moment model as having potential to extend a quantitative masking-strength analysis that is limited to first-order leakages. It leaves the higher-order extension as a future direction.
citation_labels: Gilles Barthe et al., Parallel Implementations of Masking Schemes and the Bounded Moment Leakage Model
